places.name: Corcovado National Park (Sirena Station)
places.ai_summary: Corcovado National Park is a biodiverse paradise, home to rare wildlife, pristine rainforests, and stunning beaches. The Sirena Station is the heart of the park, offering guided tours and overnight stays.
places.place_tip: Book a guided tour to explore the park's diverse ecosystems.
places.address: Corcovado National Park, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Drake Bay
places.ai_summary: Drake Bay is a tranquil coastal area known for its stunning beaches, vibrant marine life, and access to Corcovado National Park. It's a gateway for snorkeling, diving, and wildlife tours.
places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to explore nearby islands and marine reserves.
places.address: Drake Bay, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Cano Island Biological Reserve (Snorkeling)
places.ai_summary: Cano Island Biological Reserve is a marine sanctuary offering crystal-clear waters, vibrant coral reefs, and abundant marine life. It's a top destination for snorkeling and diving enthusiasts.
places.place_tip: Bring your own snorkeling gear for a more personalized experience.
places.address: Cano Island, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Puerto Jiménez Town
places.ai_summary: Puerto Jiménez is a vibrant town on the Osa Peninsula, serving as a gateway to Corcovado National Park. It offers a range of services, including accommodations, dining, and tour operators.
places.place_tip: Explore the local shops and restaurants for a taste of the local culture.
places.address: Puerto Jiménez, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Matapalo Beach
places.ai_summary: Matapalo Beach is a beautiful and secluded beach located on the Osa Peninsula. It's known for its stunning sunsets, tide pools, and as a great spot for surfing and fishing.
places.place_tip: Visit during low tide to explore the tide pools.
places.address: Matapalo Beach, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Osa Rainforest Night Tour
places.ai_summary: Experience the magic of the rainforest at night on the Osa Rainforest Night Tour. Observe nocturnal wildlife, listen to the sounds of the jungle, and enjoy a guided walk through the rainforest.
places.place_tip: Wear long sleeves and pants to protect against insect bites.
places.address: Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Golfo Dulce Dolphin Watching
places.ai_summary: Golfo Dulce is a beautiful gulf located on the Osa Peninsula, known for its calm waters and abundant marine life. Dolphin watching tours are popular here, offering a chance to see these playful creatures in their natural habitat.

opening_hours.notes: Best time for dolphin watching is early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the dolphins' acrobatics.
places.address: Golfo Dulce, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Piedras Blancas National Park
places.ai_summary: Piedras Blancas National Park is a protected area on the Osa Peninsula, known for its rich biodiversity, including endangered species like the jaguar and the scarlet macaw. The park offers hiking trails and guided tours.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for a chance to see rare wildlife.
places.address: Piedras Blancas National Park, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: La Leona Ranger Station Hike
places.ai_summary: The La Leona Ranger Station Hike is a popular trail in Corcovado National Park, leading hikers through pristine rainforest to the stunning La Leona Beach. The trail is rich in wildlife and offers a true jungle experience.
places.place_tip: Pack plenty of water and snacks for the hike.
places.address: La Leona Ranger Station, Corcovado National Park, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to taste fresh, organic chocolate.

places.name: Puerto Jiménez Mangrove Kayak
places.ai_summary: Explore the mangroves of Puerto Jiménez by kayak, a unique way to experience the local ecosystem. Kayaking tours offer a chance to see mangrove wildlife and learn about the importance of mangroves to the environment.
places.place_tip: Wear sunscreen and insect repellent.
places.address: Puerto Jiménez, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Bosque del Cabo Trails
places.ai_summary: The Bosque del Cabo Trails offer a network of hiking trails in the Osa Peninsula, ranging from easy walks to challenging hikes. The trails wind through pristine rainforest and offer opportunities to see diverse wildlife.
places.place_tip: Bring plenty of water and wear sturdy shoes.
places.address: Bosque del Cabo, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Golfo Dulce Whale Watching (Seasonal)
places.ai_summary: Golfo Dulce is a beautiful gulf located on the Osa Peninsula, known for its calm waters and abundant marine life. During the whale watching season, tours are available to see humpback whales and other marine species.

opening_hours.notes: Best time for whale watching is during the migration season (August to October).

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars and a camera for wildlife viewing.
places.address: Golfo Dulce, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.place_tip: Visit early in the morning or late in the afternoon to avoid crowds.
places.address: Playa Pan Dulce, Osa Peninsula, Costa Rica

places.name: Carbonera Beach Sunset
places.ai_summary: Carbonera Beach is a beautiful beach located on the Osa Peninsula, known for its stunning sunsets, tide pools, and as a great spot for swimming and relaxing.
places.place_tip: Stay for sunset to enjoy the breathtaking views.
